Definition: A source article identified by Record_ID and DOI.
A material, formulation, carrier or engineered construct that is the source node of validated edges.
A verified constituent of a material platform.
A verified material manufacturing or processing operation.
A material/platform design class used by a validated study system.
A stimulus directly causing a validated material behavior change.
A directly observed material response behavior; retained as an ontology type even when not the edge target.
A therapeutic molecule, protein, nucleic acid, organelle, cell product or ion actually delivered/released by a platform.
A cell type directly tested as an intervention target.
A senescence marker or induction evidence class; retained as an ontology type for future extension.
A mechanism, pathway or molecular node directly supported by study evidence.
An experimental disease/injury model; retained as an ontology type for future extension.
A directly reported repair or regenerative endpoint.
